children: Westlake appointed Tommy E. Darby as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer, effective August 31, 2026, and Jeffrey A. Holy will transition to Vice President, Finance and Investor Relations concurrent with Darby's appointment.
Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer (also VP, Chief Accounting Officer of Westlake Chemical Partners GP LLC)
Vice President, Finance and Investor Relations (transitioning from VP, Chief Accounting Officer)
Successor for Holy as Chief Accounting Officer: Tommy E. Darby

Previously VP & Chief Accounting Officer and VP & Controller at Pactiv Evergreen Inc. (Aug 2022–Apr 2025); leadership roles at Valaris (Mar 2008–May 2020); audit at Deloitte; BS in Accounting and MS in Auditing & Financial Accounting (Univ. of North Texas); CPA.
Previously served as Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer of the Company (prior role); additional background not disclosed in filing.
